title: UOCAVA overseas/military ballot-mailing deadline — the date Missouri's congressional-map fight goes moot for 11-03
source: NEWS: the Missouri Attorney General's emergency application to the US Supreme Court, Hoskins v. von Glahn, No. 26A___ (filed 2026-09-04), published at ago.mo.gov and fetched direct 2026-09-05 with its PDF text layer decompressed locally: 'absent a stay, Missouri will be forced to violate the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act (UOCAVA), which sets a deadline of September 19 to start sending absentee ballots to overseas and military voters. 52 U.S.C. § 20302(a)(8)', and elsewhere 'UOCAVA requires Missouri to send mail ballots to overseas and military voters by September 19 — 15 days from now'. Filed estimate on two counts: the statute itself (52 U.S.C. § 20302(a)(8), the 45-days-before-a-federal-election rule) was not read direct, only a party's brief characterizing it, and this calendar has no confirmed source prefix for a statute or a court filing — the same mechanical gap recorded on missouri-map-ballot-deadline-2026-09-08 and midterm-elections-2026-11-03
notes: Proposed by the missouri-map-ballot-deadline-2026-09-08 initial research (2026-09-05) as the date that actually binds, after that research found the 09-08 entry mis-specified: 09-08 is a state ballot-administration deadline (Mo. Rev. Stat. § 115.125.2) that the applicant's own filing says the US Supreme Court 'is not bound by'. This is the federal one. Once ballots are printed and mailed under a map, no order restores the other one for 2026-11-03, so this is the terminal date of the Missouri map dispute for that election whichever way Hoskins v. von Glahn comes out. The applicant asks for a decision by 09-14 precisely to leave five days before it. Not a market event: symbols: [], and the underlying ruling on 09-03 drew no measurable index reaction (VIX 15.20 → 14.32 → 14.53 across 09-02→09-04). Tracked as a seat-math input to midterm-elections-2026-11-03 and as the score-by anchor for that dispute's forward tests. Ledger: docs/research/events/missouri-map-ballot-deadline-2026-09-08.md
